events.title: 2026 Greater Atlanta GAPI Regional Meeting & MSRF Health Fair
events.location: Jade Banquets - 4675 River Green Parkway, Duluth, GA 30096
events.description:
Greater Atlanta GAPI Regional Meeting & MSRF Health Fair – A Grand Success

The Georgia Association of Physicians of Indian Heritage (GAPI) successfully hosted the Greater Atlanta GAPI Regional Meeting on Saturday, January 17, 2026, at Jade Banquets, Duluth, Georgia. The event was conducted by Dr. Lalitha Medepalli, MD, FACC, Immediate Past President of GAPI (2025–26).

MSRF 2025–26 leadership team hosted GAPI MSRF-led Health Fair. The first ever MSRF Health Fair, held from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, served over 60 community members and was organized by MSRF executive team: Anita Medepalli, Varun Nukala, Keerti Soundappan and Dr. Avi Singh. Attendees actively participated in hands-on CPR training for bystanders, preventive health screenings, diabetes screening, lifestyle counseling, and Ayurvedic and homeopathy consultations.
